Hi Alex / Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team is excited to get the pilot running. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of billing items before we issue the PO:

- Can Redwood extend Net60 for the pilot period (90 days)? We typically run 60 for first-time vendors while approvals are in place.
- For EU VAT: BrightBridge will be doing a reverse-charge (we're VAT-registered in GB and the EU). We need invoices that list the VAT reverse-charge wording and our VAT id (GB123456789).
- Any chance of splitting the first invoice into two milestones (50% on activation, 50% after go-live verification)? That helps our cashflow.

I've attached the draft PO. Happy to chat if you prefer.

Best,
Anna

Subject: Re: Payment terms & VAT handling for pilot

Anna — really appreciate the clarity and the PO. I can confirm a few things up front:

- We can invoice with the reverse-charge wording and include your VAT ID. Our billing system supports that format for EU/UK customers.
- Splitting the first payment into activation / verification milestones is doable — we'll produce milestone invoices.

On Net60 for the pilot, I'll need sign-off from finance for an exception. Looping in Soojin and Marissa to propose a compromise:

Proposed compromise: Net45 for the pilot (90 days) with a modest credit-holdback policy: Redwood holds off on an incremental credit extension until two on-time payments (so essentially a conditional Net45 for 90-day pilot, reverting to Net30 afterwards unless credit terms are extended). This helps reduce exposure during an unfamiliar billing relationship.

Anna — is that acceptable? If it is, Soojin / Marissa can run the quick credit check and we can finalize the DocuSign terms.

Thanks,
Alex
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Anna — thanks for the PO and context. A few quick notes from finance so we can get this executed quickly: 

- Credit check: we ran a routine confirmation on BrightBridge (trade references look clean). To approve Net60 we would require either a purchase order with a corporate guarantee or a minimal upfront deposit equal to 25% of the first-month invoice. For pilots we can be flexible.
- Alternate workflow: Net45 with a 10% holdback on each milestone invoice for the first two invoices, released after the second on-time payment. This is slightly different from Alex's suggested wording but similar in spirit.
- VAT: we'll issue invoices that reference the reverse-charge and include your VAT id. However, per our tax counsel, for UK-to-EEA services (post-Brexit complexities) we may need your EU VAT registration for the member state where the service is used. If you can confirm the operating country and VAT id, we'll include the correct domestic text.

Action items for Anna: confirm you can either (A) provide a 25% activation deposit; or (B) accept Net45 with a 10% milestone holdback for the first two invoices. Also confirm the VAT registration country and the VAT id to print on invoice.

If you accept Net45 + holdback we'll issue a short credit exception memo and a DocuSign addendum (no legal redline expected).

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Accounts Receivable
Redwood Inference
